item.title: Disruptive raises $10B fund to make big bets on at least 10 companies
item.description: Disruptive has made headlines in recent years for pouring money into companies like chip startup Groq and the AI voice-generation startup ElevenLabs.

item.title: Frontier AI labs say their models refuted the Exponential Time Hypothesis. What does that mean?
item.description: TechCrunch spoke to the MIT computer scientist charged with explaining OpenAI's latest mind-bending discovery.

item.title: Google’s Genie 4 world model adds audio, more realistic worlds, and real-time steering
item.description: Genie 4 can maintain a consistent scene for up to two minutes, double Genie 3's limit, and offers better physics and more humanlike characters.

item.title: Meta AI director Rohit Patel leaves to take on Microsoft Office and Google Workspace
item.description: Rohit Patel is departing Meta after eight years working on AI evaluations and reinforcement learning, TechCrunch has exclusively learned. His startup, Ndoc, aims to take on Microsoft Office Suite.

item.title: Japan internet giant GMO says hackers posted stolen customer data
item.description: Japan's GMO Internet is verifying alleged customer data posted by suspected hackers following a cloud service breach.

item.title: Opera introduces a new web standard to let users deploy AI locally in their browser
item.description: The new standard, WebAI, is designed to work with a variety of AI models.

item.title: General Compute raises $100 million Series A, countering the neocloud disaster narrative
item.description: General Compute is betting on inference chips from outside the Nvidia ecosystem.

item.title: Nvidia backs Indian startup helping companies run AI models with fewer GPUs
item.description: Simplismart says its annualized revenue run rate has grown 14-fold in six months, with the U.S. accounting for more than half its revenue.

item.title: How OpenAI turned its coding tools into dots, an always-on personal assistant
item.description: Alexander Embiricos, the OpenAI executive responsible for dots, never wants to have a meeting with someone else's AI agent.

item.title: Cohere says Alibaba’s Qwen model tried to send a file to Beijing
item.description: An AI model said it wouldn’t use any tools, then tried to send something to a server in Beijing anyway, and while researchers say it’s probably a training quirk and not espionage, the whole thing has people asking how much to trust free Chinese AI.

item.title: Anthropic’s IPO filing reveals its strategy for keeping enterprise customers hooked
item.description: Anthropic’s S-1 shows more than half of its $100,000-plus customers now use both the Claude Platform and a first-party app, a cross-selling playbook reminiscent of Amazon that’s making enterprise customers stickier.

item.title: SpaceX locks in $40B GPU financing deal with Apollo
item.description: The financing gives SpaceX another way to fund its rapidly expanding AI ambitions without relying solely on traditional debt markets.

item.title: Anthropic officially files for its public debut
item.description: Anthropic has officially filed for an IPO, revealing soaring revenue, mounting losses, major enterprise adoption, and an unusual governance structure designed to preserve founder control and its AI safety mission.

item.title: Grok releases the first seven minutes of its AI-generated ‘Odyssey’
item.description: The footage looks okay, as long as you're not seeking artistry, inspiration, or human interest.

item.title: AI delivers ‘zero financial payoff’ to most companies, Apollo economist says
item.description: "Despite massive investments and widespread hype around artificial intelligence, the technology has delivered zero financial payoff to corporate America outside of tech."

item.title: The hottest AI wearables and gadgets you should know about
item.description: We compiled a list of all the hottest AI wearables, including Muse Charm, Bee, Friend, Plaud, and more.

item.title: Will AI expose the rickety infrastructure of the internet?
item.description: The moment you realize the internet is "held together by glue and dreams."

item.title: The AI graveyard: a running list of projects and startups that didn’t make it
item.description: From Apple's repeatedly delayed Siri AI to OpenAI's messy "super app" launch, here's a look at the AI projects that shut down or missed expectations.

item.title: Block’s new voice model sounds eerily human
item.description: Typically, speech models are paired with a large language model for knowledge retrieval. Block said that Dessa's knowledge stems from the conversational data it has.

item.title: Forced to pick, Grok’s AI model chooses Republicans. OpenAI’s picks Democrats.
item.description: A new study found Grok's AI overwhelmingly recommends Republican candidates while OpenAI's GPT favors Democrats, with the two AI models disagreeing in more than 90% of nearly 500 election races.
